parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment only briefly references "the introduction part" in relation to its final claim that the introduction did not persuade the reviewer. All other issues raised—confusing and inconsistent motivation, unclear relationship between sequence-labeling tasks, low-resource settings, and the FISH-DIP method, and questioning of the method's applicability—are not tied to any specific section, table, or figure, so the authors cannot confidently determine which parts of the paper the majority of the comment addresses. Per the rubric, this grounding level matches a mid-tier description where the addressed part cannot be confidently identified. The comment does clearly specify what the issues are: the motivation is confusing, the relationship between tasks and the method is unclear, and the claimed superiority for low-resource settings is unpersuasive. Therefore, while the comment is specific about the criticisms, its grounding is weak because most issues lack an explicit, obvious anchor in the paper.
